title: Young people’s choices shaped by economic uncertainty
discussion_signal: UNFPA frames partnership and parenthood choices as shaped by financial security, stable work, housing, gender equality, reproductive rights, and social protection rather than fertility targets alone. The discussion makes demographic change a question of room to plan a life and exercise agency.
linked_research_question: How do housing, work, security, and care conditions shape partnership, parenthood, and demographic agency?
limits: Survey findings are summarized rather than independently analyzed here
LinkedIn discussion is not a representative demographic sample
